metadata.name: GetTransactionTokenDetails
metadata.description: This API is use to get Token details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one account identifier is required.

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch Default Value would be 50. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Default value would be 0 Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Skey
children.description: Unique number for each token Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1

children.name: TokenNumberLastFourDigit
children.description: Last 4 digits of Token number Valid Values: 0-9 Example:0188 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: TokenNumberHash
children.description: Encrypted token number created by System. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1537407615

children.name: TokenStatus
children.description: Token status Valid Values: A - Active D - Deactivated E - Expired S - Suspended P - Pending Activation Example:A Allowable Values: 1

children.name: TokenType
children.description: Token Type Valid Values: C = MasterCard Cloud Based Payments F = Card on File S = Embedded Secure ElementDE System Example:C Allowable Values: 1

children.name: TokenRequesterID
children.description: ID of the Token requestor provided by the association. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:01234567890 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TokenReferenceID
children.description: Reference ID of Token provided by the association. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:01234567890 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TokenExpiryDate
children.description: Expiration date of the Token. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example: 03/21/2024

children.name: DeviceID
children.description: Device ID of the Token requestor. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:abc1234 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DeviceName
children.description: Device name of the token requestor Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:abc Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DeviceType
children.description: Device Type Valid Values: 0-9 Example:01 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DeviceNumber
children.description: Device Number of the token requestor. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:01234567890 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TokenWalletID
children.description: Wallet ID of token. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:103 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PANUniqueReference
children.description: The Unique identifier of the card. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:P12312123456789012345678901234567890123456789012 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TokenUniqueReferece
children.description: The unique identifier of token. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example:D12312123456789012345678901234567890123456789012 Allowable Values: 50
